title: Google\Cloud\Datastore\Admin\V1\EntityFilter
name: EntityFilter
description: Identifies a subset of entities in a project. This is specified as combinations of kinds and namespaces (either or both of which may be all, as described in the following examples).

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.kinds
params.description: If empty, then this represents all kinds.

params.name: data.namespace_ids
params.description: An empty list represents all namespaces. This is the preferred usage for projects that don't use namespaces. An empty string element represents the default namespace. This should be used if the project has data in non-default namespaces, but doesn't want to include them. Each namespace in this list must be unique.

methods.name: getKinds
methods.description: If empty, then this represents all kinds.

methods.name: setKinds
methods.description: If empty, then this represents all kinds.

methods.name: getNamespaceIds
methods.description: An empty list represents all namespaces. This is the preferred usage for projects that don't use namespaces.

methods.name: setNamespaceIds
methods.description: An empty list represents all namespaces. This is the preferred usage for projects that don't use namespaces.
